script: $ico = Get-ChildItem (Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'PddPrint') -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName 'Image\logo48.ico' } | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($ico) { Copy-Item -Path $ico -Destination (Join-Path $dir 'pddprintclient.ico') -Force }
